rubric_items.reason: Tests cover the changed repo subquery, the service localDay mapping and the web column. REQ-10 and REQ-11 (search and sort unchanged) are not traced, although impl says it covers them.
Assertions check observable values: the day for each zone, null, '-', column order and the absence of the raw instant and medical history. The S-1 AC4 web test is carried over from impl, not new.
Many edge cases: no appointments, only Scheduled, later Cancelled or No-show, closing order vs start order, two zones. GET /api/patients changed but has no error-path test.
Vitest/Supertest on a throwaway PostgreSQL for the API and Vitest/jsdom/Testing Library for web, with test names led by IDs. Test files are in api/test and web/src/__tests__ as the strategy says.
The artifact states no invented numbers and says coverage is unavailable. It says checks.json records test counts, but checks.json has none; the counts are only in the verifier test.log.

findings.text: GET /api/patients changed (new last_visit_date), but every listed API test is a normal or edge path. No error-path test exists, e.g. a bad page or page_size, or an unauthenticated request still being refused after the query change.

cites.quote: with the normal path and the edge paths for each changed function

findings.suggested_fix: Add at least one error-path test for GET /api/patients, e.g. an invalid page parameter or a missing auth token, and check that the response is unchanged by the new subquery.

findings.text: The ut trace drops REQ-10 and REQ-11 (search and sort unchanged), which impl lists as known. The artifact does not say which test guards them after the list query changed.

cites.quote: trace: [REQ-1, REQ-2, REQ-3, REQ-4, REQ-5, REQ-6, REQ-7, REQ-8, REQ-9, REQ-12, REQ-13]
REQ-9, REQ-10, REQ-11: filters, order, page size and total untouched.

findings.suggested_fix: Trace REQ-10 and REQ-11 to the existing patients.test.ts search and sort tests, or add HMS-4 REQ-10 and REQ-11 tests on data that has a last visit.

findings.text: The artifact says tsl records test counts in checks.json. checks.json only has a pass status for the test step (report_sha256 null); the counts appear only in verifier/ut/test.log.

cites.quote: tsl records the test counts in checks.json when it runs the verifier (H3)

findings.suggested_fix: Point to the verifier test log for counts, or drop the statement that checks.json holds them.

findings.text: The web test kept from impl is named 'HMS-4 S-1 AC4', not with a REQ ID. This breaks the artifact's own C3 rule that every test name starts with its ID (here REQ-3).

cites.quote: HMS-4 S-1 AC4: shows the hospital-local day as returned when the browser zone is west of UTC
Every test name starts with HMS-4 and its REQ id (C3)

findings.suggested_fix: Rename it to 'HMS-4 REQ-3: ...' so the name leads with the requirement ID.

cites.quote: API tests use Vitest and Supertest against a throwaway PostgreSQL 16 with a fixed clock.

Web tests use
